source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Attacks by **TYRANIDS MONSTER** models of yours get:

- +1 on **[Hit rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** while the model's unit is under its **[Starting Strength](vsdata:core-rule/units-and-models)**.
- +1 on **[Wound rolls](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)** too while that unit has fallen **Below Half-strength**.

A **TYRANIDS MONSTER** unit of yours at full [Starting Strength](vsdata:core-rule/units-and-models) that is not **[Battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)** gives its models +2 [Objective Control](vsdata:core-rule/level-of-control).
